description: The operations of berth serve. Every operation of a host is one here too: on the portal with `"host": "NAME"` in the frame, over HTTP under /v1/hosts/NAME. Only the `secrets` task is refused; the host's `secrets` action sends the server's own. An action's own role is asked when it runs. Each operation names the least role a caller over TCP needs: view, operate or admin.
